name: San Jose Signs
audience: Storefront owners, restaurants, clinics, property managers and fleet operators
description: Sign shop in the Alviso-side industrial area making illuminated channel letters, monument signs, window graphics and vehicle wraps, with a 72-photo archive of installed work.
serviceCopy: Illuminated channel letters, engineered for the facade.
Monuments and pylons with city permitting.
Wraps and fleet lettering cut in-house.
insight: A 30-year veteran crew and 72 documented installs: this is a portfolio business with no portfolio.
usps: Handles the permit process end to end
Thirty-year veterans in a shop of young resellers
differentiators: Publishes material, illumination and permit options with real cost bands
persona: The sign makers with the machines

reputation.note: Small review base with strong photographic proof - lead with work, not scores.

afford: Own fabrication equipment and a shop lease
Permit and city-approval expertise is a differentiator nobody publishes
risk: Trade customers often buy by phone: keep the funnel short
Photos are customer-owned on a platform: licensing must be cleared

art.logo: Set a bold geometric sans wordmark, no 3D bevel effects
art.photoNote: Installed facades at night, wrap in progress, CNC bed

copy.h1: Your sign was made in a shop, not a website builder.
copy.sub: Channel letters, monuments, wraps and permits - designed, fabricated and installed in one South San Jose shop.
copy.lede: Nearly every storefront sign in this city passes through a reseller. San Jose Signs owns the printers, the brake and the install crew - and has nowhere to show it.

concept.dir: Shop-floor brutalist: big industrial type, an installed-work mosaic lit by a night toggle, permit and material spec tables, and a measurement upload flow. Motion: hard-cut reveals, no shimmer.
interactive: Day/night toggle that lights the facade photography
Sign-type selector with typical cost bands and lead times
Permit process explainer with city notes
concept.refs: A fabricator catalogue, not an agency portfolio.

web.note: Listing shows 72 photos of installed work and no website field; no domain surfaced in the directories reviewed. A fabrication shop whose entire portfolio lives on someone else's platform.
web.confidence: verified across two or more directories
